Title: Primary resistance to single and multiple drugs in leprosy: a mouse footpad study

Abstract:

Skin biopsy homogenates obtained from three cases of lepromatous lepros with no prior history of antileprosy treatment were tested in the mouse footpad for the sensitivity of Mycobacterium leprae to multiple drugs. This in vitro test model allowed us to assess the sensitivity of M. leprae to several antileprosy drugs tested simultaneously, a more realistic scenario as the treatment of leprosy in man is often polypharmacic. This study compares the sensitivity of M. leprae to  the antileprosy drugs rifampicin, dapsone, clofazimine, clofibrate, and ethambutol and also compares the combined effects of pairs of drugs and of the three of these drugs. The results of the test are compared with the in vitro results of M. leprae to the same drugs.  These tests have shown that in some lepromatous lepros, M. leprae was resistant to some or to all these drugs and that resistance to one drug may cause the resistance to the others.

Key words: leprosy, mycobacterium leprae, rifampicin, dapsone, clofazimine, clofibrate, ethambutol, lepromatous leprosy, mouse footpad test.

As a member of the testis-specific serine/threonine protein kinase (TSSK) family, Tssk4 is exclusively expressed in the testis and plays an essential role in male fertility. We previously reported that Tssk4 was involved in regulating the spindle stability and chromosome segregation during male meiosis by phosphorylating Cdc2 related protein (Cdc2r1A), but the regulatory mechanism of Tssk4 involved in male fertility is complex and unclear completely. To further explore the detail mechanism of how Tssk4 works in male meiosis, we screened several proteins which are potential to be the substrate of Tssk4, and find that Odf2 is a candidate of the substrate of Tssk4. In this study, we found that Tssk4 phosphorylates Odf2 at Ser-76 in vitro, and this phosphorylation is very important for Odf2 to have its function in meiotic spindle assembly. So Tssk4-Odf2 axis may be a new way for Tssk4 to regulate the meiotic process, and it also provides a new clue for us to understand how Tssk4 is involved in the male meiosis and male fertility.

Key Words: TSSK4, ODF2, phosphorylation, meiotic spase, mani fyticity 

This study provides a new information for TSSK4 function in the meiosis and the meiotic protein.

Abstract

The photon decay of the relativisttic Coulomb excitation of the 2-phonon GDR in the target has been observed in 1 AGeV 209 Bi on 208 Pb. The photon spectrometer BigBen8 and the neutron and proton detectors FMA were used to detect the emitted photons and the emitted nucleons. The BigBen8 photon spectrometer detects photons from 100 keV to 11 MeV. The cross section for the 2-phonon GDR state has been measured for the first time with this experiment. The cross section is 1.02 mb. The mean energy of the 2-phonon GDR is 16.5 MeV. The width of the 2-photon GDR is 4.5 MeV. The results are compared to a theoretical calculation done with the code REGTOG. The code RECOG calculates the relativistic excitation of the nucleus when it is excited by a relativisitc nucleus. The code RECOG uses the relativistic distorted wave born approximation. The results from the code RECOG are compared to the results from this experiment. The code RECOG was also used to calculate the cross section for the 2-phonon GDR and the mean energy of the 2-phonon GD R and the width of the 2-phonon GDR. The code RECOG calculates a cross section of 1.1 mb for the 2- phonon GDR state. The code RECOG also calculates a mean energy of 16.7 MeV and a width of 4.3 MeV for the 2-phonon GDR. The results from the code RECOG and this experiment are compared in the discussion.

The photon spectrometer BigBen8 and the neutron and proton detectors FMA were used to detect the emitted photons and the emitted nucleons. The BigBen8 photon spectrometer detects photons from 100 keV to 11 MeV. The cross section for the 2-phonon GDR state has been measured for the first time with this experiment. The cross section is 1.02 mb. The mean energy of the 2-phonon GDR is 16.5 MeV. The width of the 2-photon GDR is 4.5 MeV. The results are compared to a theoretical calculation done with the code REGTOG. The code RECOG calculates the relativistic excitation of the nucleus when it is excited by a relativisitc nucleus. The code RECOG uses the relativistic distorted wave born approximation. The results from the code RECOG are compared to the results from this experiment. The code RECOG was also used to calculate the cross section for the 2-phonon GDR and the mean energy of the 2-phonon GD R and the width of the 2-phonon GDR. The code RECOG calculates a cross section of 1.1 mb for the 2- phonon GDR state. The code RECOG also calculates a mean energy of 16.7 MeV and a width of 4.3 MeV for the 2-phonon GDR.
